verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a Case Management workspace where analysts review alerts, conduct investigations and resolve cases, and describes 'audit-ready' AML agents. Together these imply an investigation record, but nothing explicitly describes analysts attaching evidence, writing notes or recording decision reasons in a case history. Missing for 10: documented ability to add notes or evidence to cases, recorded decision/disposition reasons, a viewable investigation history or audit trail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
